specs.title: should complete full search flow: type locations → search → see results
should expand bus row and show stops when clicked
should show map with stops markers when bus is expanded
should sort buses by different criteria
should allow editing search and fetch new results
should filter buses by type if filter available
should show bus details like fare, duration, stops count
should display search inputs on homepage
should not have critical console errors
should display search form on homepage
